text:
Sodium ions, Na+, and oxygen ions, O2–, combine with chromium ions to form a salt.
The salt sodium dichromate has the formula Na2Cr2O7.
What is the oxidation state of chromium in this salt?
A
+2
B
+3
C
+6
D
+12
subject: Chemistry
